<issue>
GPX smoothing algorithm causes IndexError when accessing array indices

#### Description

When calling the `smooth()` method on GPX track segments, the algorithm fails with an IndexError due to incorrect array index calculations in the smoothing logic.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import gpxpy
import gpxpy.parser as mod_parser

# Load a GPX file and apply smoothing
with open('test_files/track-with-extremes.gpx') as f:
    parser = mod_parser.GPXParser(f)
gpx = parser.parse()

# This will raise IndexError
gpx.smooth(vertical=True, horizontal=True, remove_extremes=True)
```

The error also occurs with other smoothing combinations:

```python
# These also fail
gpx.smooth(vertical=True, horizontal=False, remove_extremes=True)
gpx.smooth(vertical=False, horizontal=True, remove_extremes=True)
gpx.smooth(vertical=True, horizontal=True)
```

#### Expected Behavior

The smoothing algorithm should process the track points without raising IndexError and successfully smooth the track data.

#### Actual Behavior

The method raises `IndexError: list index out of range` when trying to access array elements during the smoothing calculations.
</issue>
